case_name: Tenerife banana pseudostems: electricity feasibility screening

region_context.use: Context only. Fruit production is not residue availability or contracted feed.

feedstock_measurements.sample_location: Galdar, Gran Canaria; laboratory assays in Madrid
feedstock_measurements.transfer_limit: Adjacent-island proxy, not a Tenerife feedstock measurement. Raw pseudostem only; excludes fruit, rachis and leaves.

financial_basis: Assumed constant 2026 EUR, unlevered and pre-tax. No supplier quotations, market-price forecast, grant, tax, debt, land purchase or heat/digestate/carbon sales. Transport rate is assumed to include the empty return; loaded distance is one-way. Residue handling is charged per incoming tonne, not a predicted digestate mass. No disposal saving is claimed for material otherwise retained on farms.

ces_2024.title: Consejo Economico y Social de Canarias, Informe Anual 2024
ces_2024.locator: Table 40, printed page 86 (PDF page 88), Tenerife 2024 row; source attributed to ASPROCAN
ces_2024.role: Published island production context; this pinned 2024 series is not represented as the latest production estimate.

duran_2026.title: Duran Hernandez et al. (2026), Methane production from the co-digestion of banana crop residues and the organic fraction of municipal solid waste: influence of steam explosion
duran_2026.locator: Accepted manuscript: section 2.1; Table 3 raw P (PDF page 19); Table 6 P (PDF page 24); section 2.3 gas reference conditions
duran_2026.role: Raw pseudostem TS, VS/TS and blank-corrected laboratory BMP. Not a continuous-plant guarantee; no steam-explosion uplift applied.

nrel_sam.title: NREL, LCOE in SAM using FCR and Single Owner Financial Models (2020)
nrel_sam.role: Discounted lifecycle cost/energy convention only. This example does not implement SAM financing or tax treatment and obtains no cost assumptions from this source.
